blurb.roadmap: Eight weeks, sequenced so each block builds on the last.
blurb.mock: Timed rounds with a question draw and a notes pad.
blurb.cards: Spaced drill over the whole question bank.
blurb.dsa: 116 curated problems, grouped by the pattern that solves them.
blurb.bank: Short-answer questions with the answer you would actually give.
blurb.ml: Bias–variance, regularisation, metrics, trees — with the figures.
blurb.llm: Tokenisation through serving: the core of an AI-engineer loop.
blurb.aieng: Architecture, cost, monitoring and governance in production.
blurb.ts: Stationarity to foundation models: forecasting, anomalies, production.
blurb.hld: Eight full designs with estimates, diagrams and trade-offs.
blurb.lld: Machine-coding problems with working reference implementations.
blurb.classic: Ten “design X” product cases, each a timed sixty-minute walkthrough.
blurb.infra: Queues, stores, caches, schedulers — the primitives the products assume.
blurb.swe: Design principles, testing, APIs, delivery, architecture, security and leadership.
blurb.py: Object model, generators, decorators, the GIL, asyncio, typing, testing and production Python.
blurb.scale: Caching, databases, replication, sharding, consistency, queues, resilience, SLOs, Kubernetes and multi-region.
blurb.net: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/1.1–3, TLS, proxies, WebSockets, CDNs, sockets, security and debugging.
blurb.mlc: Implement it from scratch in NumPy: regression, trees, backprop, attention, RoPE, BPE, decoding, LoRA — every solution tested.
blurb.mm: ViTs, CLIP, VLM architectures, diffusion, speech, voice agents, video, documents, grounding and serving.
blurb.rs: Chain of thought, test-time compute, PPO, GRPO and RLVR, reward hacking, distillation and honest evaluation.
blurb.gpu: Rooflines, FLOPs and bytes, precision formats, CUDA, Triton, FlashAttention, collectives, FSDP, inference modelling and cost.
